Flat Pack Container Houses

Flat pack (knock-down) container houses are built from prefabricated wall panels on a galvanized steel frame, shipped in compact flat packs and assembled on site with simple tools. The design keeps freight costs low, supports rapid deployment, and allows full disassembly and reuse for the next project. A practical choice for contractors, developers and relief organizations.

Key Features

Why Buyers Choose This Range

  • Knock-down flat pack design
  • Low freight volume
  • Tool-light on-site assembly
  • Fully reusable across projects
  • Flexible module combinations
  • Rapid deployment
